Maya: Quick check-in: we need to finalize GA gating for the pilot tomorrow. Key items: SLA wording, runbook owner, monitoring probes, and whether pilot uses tiered pricing or flat trial.
Jon: My view: split SLOs by traffic shape. Interactive = latency targets; background/batch = throughput targets.
Priya: Draft SLOs for discussion: interactive p95 < 300ms, p99 < 600ms for seq_len <=1024. Batch: maintain 400 req/s 99th per dedicated node. Document long-context as best-effort.
Arjun: Agree, add conditional clause: seq_len >1024 flagged in docs as "no latency guarantee" and routes should surface warning to customers. I'll take runbook ownership and add detection -> impact -> rollback steps.
Liam: Rollback policy: if p99 misses target for 3 consecutive 10m windows OR error rate >2x baseline for 30m -> trigger canary rollback to fallback variant. Ops ticket + PagerDuty alert required.
Priya: I'll write the customer-facing SLA blurb and a short FAQ with examples (token counts, expected deltas). Include note about fallback quantization (cost ~25-35% lower, potential quality change).
Maya: Pricing for pilot: Finance suggests simple bands (dev/pro/enterprise). For pilot let's do dev = free, pro = discounted usage, enterprise = committed + reserved uplift. Liam, draft numbers for FinOps tomorrow.
Jon: Monitoring checklist: p95/p99 per-route, error rate, GPU util, KV cache hit rate, batching efficiency, synthetic probes for top customer prompts. Priya will own probes.
Arjun: Canary plan: ramp 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 24h if no SLA triggers. If error budget burn crosses threshold, immediate pause and rollback. I'll add exact cutoffs in runbook.
ops-bot: Runbook template created: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/pilot-ga-template  Fill Detection and Rollback before cutover.
Maya: Acceptance checklist to lock GA pilot: runbook reviewed, SLA blurbs in docs, monitoring + probes live, billing telemetry validated, pricing draft with FinOps, support routing defined, 48h internal burn-in.
Liam: Support mapping: pro = standard oncall; enterprise = priority escalation to SRE lead. Also confirm billing separates reserved capacity from token usage.
Maya: Actions: Arjun -> runbook + pager matrix; Priya -> SLA blurbs + FAQ + probes; Jon -> devex snippet + docs link; Liam -> pricing bands for FinOps. I'll sign-off once uploads are live.
Arjun: Starting runbook now, will tag SRE for review.
Priya: Will post draft SLA + FAQ in this thread when ready.
Maya: Great, if no objections I'll lock these decisions at EOD. :thumbsup:
Jon: No objections.
